<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Ready to build the landing page.

Planning the landing page structure. It will include a hero, social proof bar, problem and solution sections, category cards, spotlight, use-case bundles, three-step process, FAQ, and a final CTA with a signup form. Separate CSS and JS files will handle styling and interactive elements like sticky CTAs and smooth scrolling.

No internal links to /rewards, item pages, or tools will appear. Category cards and bundles remain non-clickable. Newsletter signup is the sole conversion goal. The header uses minimal navigation with scroll anchors and a Subscribe CTA. A sticky CTA appears on mobile. All copy will match the Carnival design system and be humanised.

The hero will use a CSS outcome mockup instead of lifestyle photography. Actual counts are pulled from the README: 354 total items, 149 prompts, 92 tools, 56 learning resources, 57 resources, 25 guides, 3 frameworks, 2 cheat sheets, and 2 templates. Eight categories are planned.

The spotlight will tease a cold outreach email prompt with blurred text to push visitors toward signup. Humanised copy will avoid em-dashes, "it's not X but Y" constructions, buzzwords, elliptical setups, and revelation hooks. The headline will mirror the README's "350+ ready-to-use AI prompts, tools, and guides. No fluff." pattern while remaining natural. Existing marquee and section patterns from base.css will be reused.

Proceeding with default assumptions rather than asking further questions. The landing page will replace `index.html` directly; `home.html` is unnecessary because `serve.py` already maps `/home` to `index.html`.

The header will link to What’s Inside, How it Works, and FAQ. A sticky bottom bar on mobile will hold the Subscribe CTA. Exit-intent popups are ruled out; the sticky CTA alone prevents users from leaving without signing up. The signup form will use placeholder email and disabled submit buttons with a “coming soon” note. Existing section-head and halftone styles will be reused.
</details></think>
